I {brew} the finest ales and spirits you'll find anywhere. Care to sample my {wares}?
Brewing is both an art and a science. The perfect balance of ingredients, temperature, and time.
I have various drinks for sale. Just ask about my {trade}.
My ales are brewed with the finest hops and barley. Perfect for any occasion.
Strong drinks for those who can handle them. Not for the faint of heart!

walkaway: Flee, mortal. Perhaps you are not ready.

reply: We were once the rulers of this world. Now, only memories remain... and spirits like myself.
I have witnessed ages pass. The rise and fall of civilizations. All return to dust in time.
My physical form has long since turned to ash, but my essence persists, bound to this place.
The wisdom of ages flows through me. But such knowledge is not freely given.
To prove your worth, you must show courage, wisdom, and respect for the ancient ways.
Before humans walked these lands, dragons ruled the skies. Those were glorious times.

greet: Someone made it! Do you bring word from my men in the outskirts?
Hey, I really need your {help} on an important mission urgently.

reply: Nice to meet you |PLAYERNAME|, the name's Emiliana.
I used to teach imbuing all around the tibian world, maybe someday you will meet up with Alibinius at Thais. Imbuement is such a powerful thing if done correctly.
Such a pleasant little island, it's the perfect place to enjoy my peace and finally go after my hobbies again after travelling around Tibia for quite some time.

I'd say you got two options, one reasonable and another one not as much. You could even travel with Matilda to Aragonia and see what the pirates are up to ... or you could be sane and travel to Thais with Captain Indigo and get to see the beauty of the Tibian mainland, your choice I suppose ...
Isn't that his turtle? She once got me to Aragonia and back for free. I definitely wasn't the smoothest ride, but I won't complain for that price ...

Our beloved Captain Indigo is the only way to travel to mainland from here, therefore she is the only connection for other resources, supplies and things alike. You can find and sell supplies at Aurelia's shop just south of my home.
She owns the boat on the east of Targuna, which can take you straight to Thais, whenever you so desire. I heard if you hand her a ticket you get your ride free of charge. I tell you, that's a deal!
Aurelia has a little shop just south of me, so whenever you might need new supplies or want to sell some stuff, I'd suggest paying her a visit.
Selling and buying supplies is all taken care off by our dearest Aurelia. You can find her at the south east side of Targuna, basically right south of my house.
That pirate island, yeah. Not going to be there anytime soon and I'd advise you to do the same, if you still want to leave alive. Those pirates are more dangerous than they might seem.

He's not a real pirate honestly, I think part-time seems more fitting here, nevertheless he's a nice pirate to have around. If you ever feel the need to travel to Aragonia, you should talk to him about it.
Our precious mayor Camilla takes care of every official request and everything representative in and around Targuna. She's rather new here, though we couldn't be better off with anyone else.

The mayor of Targuna has historically been residing in the upper floors and room of the depot in the middle of the Island, so if there's ever a need to visit Camilla at her office, you'll know exactly where to look.

Having Adrian as our financial advisor and helper here is surely nothing short of a blessing, so whenever you find yourself having little fortune in your pockets, pay him a visit and make sure you deposit it.
Everybody has to use the post office and so do we here on Targuna. Leonora takes care of all the work, by making it able to send and receive parcels, letters and many other things.
She told me about her research on ancient lizard groups ... May sound interesting at first, but I wouldn't want to hear that again, I'll tell you that!
She's the cute turtle that Sterling once saved from a storm at Aragonia. Before these pirates took over it used to be paradise. If you're interested in turtles, you nearly have to pay her a visit.
My portal leads to the Crimson Court. Go upstairs, open the door and walk through it.
The Herald of Fire resides somewhere in the depths of the Crimson Court. He must be stopped.
An ancient and dangerous place, reachable only through my portal.
There's a lonely ram on Targuna. Maybe it wouldn't mind a bite of turnips ...
I can teach you {attack} spells, {healing} spells and {support} spells. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? I can also tell you which spells are available at your {level}.
I am a servant and maintenance golem. I also operate the {lift}.
I require no name.
I am a servant and maintenance golem. I also operate the lift.

greet: Want to go back to {Yalahar}? Just ask me.

greet: Hold it! Are you one of Demeron's men?
Welcome to my humble hut, |PLAYERNAME|. What brings you {here}?

reply: Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
I love all animals, whether small or big. I also believe each one, even the wildest and most ferocious being, can be talked to, understood and {tamed}.
It's my dream to shelter many different tamed animals. Maybe one day that dream will come true.
Well, usually you can tame animals with the help of a few simple items. If you've found such an {item}, show it to me and I might be able to help you with instructions on the taming process.
Well? Which item have you found and require advice for?
That's among the favourite foods of donkeys, as far as I know. It's a shame I haven't really seen any donkey around. It could require a magic trick to actually get to meet one.
Pandas love to eat bamboo leaves, but the Tiquandan pandas are actually not that skilled at climbing, so they have a hard time getting some for themselves. You might be able to tame one with them.
I heard that terror birds really love carrots. I'd try waving it in front of one of those.
Ah, what a pretty ribbon. Reminds me of the elusive dragonlings - they're quite elegant and vain. They would probably welcome a decorative element. They're sometimes spotted during volcano eruptions.
What a neat little elvish gadget. Did you know a diapason works with vibrations to create sound? I actually think this could work on a creature made of crystals.
I'm against violence towards any creature. I've heard those barbarians in the desert use it for disobedient dromedaries.
Oh, what a nice little plant! Did you know it's supposed to bring luck? So is the lady bug. Both of them might actually go well together.
I've heard that there once was a gang of manta ray riders who liked to adorn their mantas with a foxtail. Don't ask me why, maybe they like how it floats in the wind when running really fast?
What a strange device! This looks like a tool for someone who creates golems and modifies living creatures. You could probably tame a modded creature with it, but I doubt they live in the wild.
Oh, that's one of the favourite foods of a crustacea gigantica. I think you can just distract it with the food and quickly jump on its back.
Have you ever encountered a magma crawler? They only eat and drink really hot things. You could probably try and make one drink some glow wine - and quickly mount it as long as it's drunk.
Hm. What an interesting find. This is definitely not used for any sort of animal. Maybe a vehicle? I can imagine it could be used for a bike of some sorts.
That looks like it might fit a draptor. If you can ever get close enough to one to catch it, I'd simply try putting it on while whispering calming words.
The sound of a hunting horn is often intimidating to forest creatures, but I heard that wild boars actually like it.
Ironblights consist mainly of stone and iron. With a strong magnet like that you can basically force it to walk in the direction you're wanting it to.
Try catching a midnight panther using that one. Don't hit the panther, mind you. Just let the whip crack in the air - I think that will work.
As far as I know, leeches can be found in terrestrial, swampy areas. Leeches often help large animals such as water buffaloes to get rid of parasites.
You should show that giant jaw to a creature looking like the one you got it from. It will respect you when it sees those scary teeth.
Where did you get that? What a rare treat. This must have been crafted by someone who truly loves both music and animals. I can't tell you anything else about it.
Oh, a nail case..., I hate paring nails. But I heard gravediggers become trusting when they get the right treatment.
How impressive, a nightmare horn. Have you ever encountered a shock head? Try hypnotizing them with your horn.
You could probably ride a black sheep with these. Talk to it gently and carefully put on the reins.
Wow, that's a rarity. Have you ever met one of those large sandstone scorpions? They're quite impressive. You need such a sceptre to show to one that you're its new master.

That might be the only way to tame a bear. It has a sensitive spot right between the ears which will calm it down, but you're not strong enough for simple acupressure. Using the slingshot is likely to help you with that.
As the name indicates - this can be used to make a slug much faster than it normally is! Once you've tamed it, it will race you wherever you want to go.

Create sugar oat by just mixing a bunch of sugar cane with a bunch of wheat. All horses love sugar oat! Sometimes when the horses from the horse station in Thais are on the loose, wild horses mix with the herd. Maybe they can be tamed?
The interesting part about that bait isn't the sweet stuff - it's the flies attracted to the sweet smell. Spiders love to eat flies, especially the Zaoan ones.
Hm! Now that's an interesting one. Where did you get that from? I could imagine it winds something up in a factory, but it's definitely not a normal animal.
In some parts of this world, creatures are using barrels to roll down hills and even mountains to entertain themselves. One can probably do the same, given the right tools and opportunity.
Well, usually you can tame animals with the help of a few simple items. If you've found such an item, show it to me and I might be able to help you with instructions on the taming process.

At first sight this candle might only illuminate your house. But this light is something special. Moles are, as you probably know, blind. Nevertheless they feel very appealed by this candle stump. That might be the way to tame them.
Oh, it looks quite old. The scribbled notes are barely readable. But I have the impression that you could borrow a very special book with this ticket.
There are creatures of darkness and cold, living on a remote island and fighting against light and warmth. It is said that they can be subdued and forced to do the bidding of others.

I heard stories about those artificial flowers. The werelions of the Darama Desert create them and they come in different colours. Each colour has a different meaning. ... White silk flowers are used as love pledges, for example. But red ones are decorations for bravery and valour. ... If you offer one respectfully to a white lion, such a kingly animal might accompany you willingly.
This piece of cloth will enable you to gather ghostly residue, that will be shaped by your willpower to create a rideable haze.

Oh, what a beautiful amulet. Really very artful and elaborate! It would be a fitting adornment even for a creature as majestic as a noble lion. If you offer it respectfully such a kingly animal might accompany you.

The Regalia of Suon! Only a few of them were ever forged, back in the times of the old empire of Kilmaresh. This is a very rare and precious treasure. The Regalia of Suon are a gift that would be worth even a gryphon's favour.
It's on the door.

I manage the {household} and ensure all {affairs} run smoothly.
A well-run household is the foundation of any noble house. Every detail must be attended to.
Financial matters, staff management, correspondence - all fall under my purview.
A steward must be trustworthy above all else. I have served faithfully for many years.
The estate has seen better days, but we maintain what we can.
Those brigands have disrupted trade terribly. It's affecting the entire region's economy.
If you're looking for work, I may have some tasks that need attending to.
There are always errands to be run and matters to be resolved.
